# WA Coexistence (Watobot)

> Get WhatsApp API access on a phone number you already use with the WhatsApp Business app, without a verified business. Coexistence lets you keep using the app normally while also building a chatbot on the API, through a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA). We are a Meta Tech Provider (approval pending), so you don't need to create your own Meta app. Free for the first 10 numbers.

Prerequisites: a phone number registered on the WhatsApp Business app, and an app (such as a chatbot) hosted at a public HTTPS URL that receives incoming messages. Your Meta access token is stored encrypted with a Watobot API key that only you hold, and incoming messages go straight from WhatsApp to your app.

## Guides

- [How to Get WhatsApp API Access in 5 Minutes](https://watobot.com/how-to/get-whatsapp-api-access-in-5-minutes.html): Connect your number through coexistence, save your Watobot API key, point incoming messages at your app and test both directions.
- [Already Have WhatsApp API? How to Migrate to Watobot](https://watobot.com/how-to/migrate-existing-whatsapp-api-to-watobot.html): What moving a number from another provider or your own Meta app involves, and what to check first.
- [How to Get WhatsApp API for Free](https://watobot.com/how-to/get-whatsapp-api-for-free.html): The do-it-yourself route: create your own Meta app, generate an access token and set up your webhook. This route does not give you coexistence.
- [How to Create a Meta Business Portfolio and Add Your WhatsApp Number](https://watobot.com/how-to/create-meta-business-portfolio-add-whatsapp-number.html): Create a business portfolio without a registered business, add your WhatsApp number to it, and get ready to connect an app.
